candidate_scope: Camera obstruction, sensor dropout and perception input corruption
Cross-sensor disagreement and unexpected road-scene changes
explicit_non_goals: Does not replace validated ADAS, collision avoidance or driver authority
No steering, braking or vehicle motion command from anomaly scores
required_gates: Require time sync, calibration, sensor health and coordinate-frame checks
Fail closed on missing/conflicting evidence or out-of-distribution inputs
Human review; independent vehicle safety systems remain authoritative
no paid API, subscription, cloud GPU, model download or new dependency without explicit approval
evidence_status: documentation_only; no model accuracy, runtime integration, hardware validation or field safety is claimed
cost_policy: zero-cost-first; no external services or downloads
